title: Synthesis, crystal structure, and conversion of CO2 of a Yb8 cluster

synthesis.procedure: H2L (0.04 mmol) and Yb(acac)3·2H2O (0.04 mmol) were mixed in ethanol (9.0 mL) and dichloromethane (4.0 mL). The mixture was sealed in a 20 mL glass vial and heated at 70 °C for 2 d. After slow cooling to room temperature, yellow block-shaped crystals of cluster 1 were obtained. Yield 37% based on Yb(acac)3·2H2O. H2L itself was prepared by refluxing 5-hydroxymethylfurfural (1.89 g, 15 mmol) and 2-salicylhydrazide (2.28 g, 15 mmol) in 50 mL absolute methanol at 80 °C for about 12 h (yield 2.83 g, 76%).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal synthesis in a sealed 20 mL glass vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After the reaction temperature was slowly decreased to room temperature, yellow block-shaped crystals were obtained.

properties.summary: Cluster 1 shows typical Yb(III) NIR luminescence in methanol at room temperature, assigned to 2F5/2 → 2F7/2, indicating ligand-to-Yb energy transfer. Reported lifetime 8.91 μs, emission quantum yield 0.21%, estimated intrinsic Yb quantum yield 0.45% and sensitization efficiency 46.7%. UV-Vis bands of 1 appear at 203, 256, 307 and 359 nm. Catalytic CO2/epoxide cycloaddition is reported but is outside magnetic/optical extraction.
